text: ツノの　かたちを　みていると　かんかくが　だんだん　おかしくなり　じぶんの　ちからで　たてなくなる。

structure.jp: ツノの　かたちを　みていると
structure.en: if you keep looking at the shape of its antlers

structure.jp: かんかくが　だんだん　おかしくなり
structure.en: your senses gradually go strange, and

structure.jp: じぶんの　ちからで

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. みていると = 'if you keep looking'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く plus なる means 'to become' that way. Ending on なり instead of なる means 'and', leading into the next part. おかしくなり = 'goes strange, and'.

patterns.name: 〜なくなる
patterns.explanation: なくなる after a verb means to reach the point of no longer doing it. たてる is 'can stand', so たてなくなる = 'you can no longer stand'.
